verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a marketplace for adding third-party plugins, skills, and MCP servers with OAuth authentication, plus native integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Linear, and more, letting teams plug partner-built tools/agents into their workflows, with enterprise admin controls over which servers are allowed. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of using specific partner-built agent apps (vs. generic tool connectors) and clearer distinction between simple MCP data-tools and full third-party 'agent apps'.
